title: Our Iconic T-Digit
slide_intent: Show how a familiar symbol can carry a composition so recognition is retained even when its treatment changes.
strategic_value: Large T-Digit installations and selective adaptations can extend T-Mobile recognition into events and communities.
demonstration: A prominent architectural T-Digit is surrounded by neon and community-specific variations.
practical_value: Choose a dominant T-Digit treatment while preserving its recognizable form and the source’s approval boundary.

ingredient.name: T-Digit
ingredient.role: Identify T-Mobile as the central visual subject.
